text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1014, Large Dragonfly Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze

The Oiled Bronze Dragonfly Door Knocker is an impressive 8-1/2 inches wide and 6-1/2 inches tall. It is great for larger doors. Dragonflies are symbolic of love and new beginnings, making this premium door knocker a great housewarming gift or wedding present. The Large Oiled Bronze Dragonfly Door Knocker is made out of sandcast brass. The Oiled Bronze finish highlights the detailing of the dragonfly's wings. The dragonfly in flight door knocker comes with surface mounting hardware for 7/8 inch hole centers.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Polished Brass and Bronze Nickel Silver

Features and Specifications of the Dragonfly Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 6-1/2
  • Width: 8-1/2"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 7/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
